title.en: ChatGPT can now send texts for you with new Apple Messages plugin

summary.en: Ever wanted someone else to do your texting for you? ChatGPT is being offered up as an automated text scribe via a new Apple Messages integration.

title.en: OK, can we actually cool data centers with our pee?
